title: Interprocess Data Read
text: Receive messages from another processor using interprocess communication channel, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Channel number} sets Select the channel number; {Enable simulation port} enables peripheral simulation port to block, {Data type}, {Circular FIFO depth} sets the number of storage buffers, {Circular FIFO element size} sets the size of data vector read from interprocess data, {Acknowledge interrupts} selects to acknowledge interrupts, {Participating cores} selects the participating cores of the processor The options vary based on the hardware board you and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: msg
ports.summary: Data message from interprocess data channel scalar

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Data frame read from another processor vector

params.name: Enable simulation port
params.values: Enable peripheral simulation port to block on (default) | off

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of interprocess data channel double (default) | single | int8 | int16 | int32 | int64 | int64 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | uint64 | uint64 | Boolean | bus

params.name: Circular FIFO depth
params.values: Number of storage buffers 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Circular FIFO element size
params.values: Size of data vector read from interprocess data channel 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Acknowledge interrupts
params.values: Select to acknowledge interrupts off (default) | on

params.name: Participating cores
params.values: Select the participating cores of the processor The options vary based on the hardware board you select
